documents.text: Membership Renewal: Retaining existing members, renewal notices, lapsed members and dues collection for returning members.
Membership Recruitment: Attracting and signing up new members, prospect outreach and join campaigns.
Annual Conference: The organization's yearly flagship meeting: sessions, speakers, venue and attendee logistics.
Webinars: Live and recorded online education sessions and virtual events.
Continuing Education: Courses, CE credits, certification maintenance and professional development requirements.
Certification: Credentialing exams, eligibility, and earning a professional designation.
Fundraising: Individual donations, donor appeals, giving campaigns and donor stewardship.
Grants: Foundation and government grant applications, awards and grant reporting.
Advocacy: Public policy, lobbying, legislation and government relations on behalf of the profession.
Volunteering: Volunteer recruitment, committee service and volunteer recognition.
Chapters: Regional and local chapter operations, chapter leaders and component relations.
Board Governance: Board of directors, bylaws, elections, fiduciary duties and governance policies.
Finance: Budgets, audits, accounting, financial statements and reserves.
Sponsorship: Corporate sponsors, exhibitors, sponsorship packages and partner benefits.
Publications: Journals, magazines, peer review and editorial calendars.
Research: Studies, surveys, data collection and research findings in the field.
Diversity and Inclusion: Equity, inclusion initiatives, accessibility and underrepresented groups in the profession.
Career Center: Job board, career openings, resume help and employer postings.
Student Members: Student chapters, student pricing, scholarships and early-career pathways.
Mentoring: Pairing experienced professionals with newer members for guidance.
Awards: Honors, award nominations, recognition programs and award ceremonies.
Technology: Association software, websites, data systems and IT projects.
Data Privacy: Personal data protection, GDPR, consent and handling of member information.
Marketing: Brand, campaigns, social media, email marketing and communications strategy.
Standards and Ethics: Codes of conduct, professional standards, ethics complaints and discipline.
Industry Partnerships: Alliances with companies, universities and other associations.
Member Benefits: Discounts, insurance, member-only resources and the value proposition of membership.
Climate and Sustainability: Environmental impact, climate policy and sustainable practices.
Water Resources: Hydrology, water supply, flood management and watershed science.
Public Health: Population health, disease prevention and health policy.

queries.q: Your membership expired on June 30. Renew today to keep your journal access and member pricing for another year.
Know a colleague who should join? Refer a friend this month and they'll get their first year at half price.
Keynote speakers for this year's gathering in Denver have been announced, and the hotel block closes September 15.
Join us online next Wednesday at noon for a 60-minute session on flood forecasting models. The recording will be posted afterward.
Practitioners must earn 30 professional development hours every two years to keep their designation active.
The spring exam window opens April 1. Candidates need three years of field experience to sit for the credential.
Our year-end appeal raised $84,000 from 1,200 individual donors. Thank-you letters go out next week.
We were awarded $250,000 by the Hudson Foundation to expand rural outreach; interim reports are due every six months.
Contact your senator before Friday's vote on the infrastructure bill, which affects licensing requirements for our field.
We're looking for people to serve on the program committee. It takes about two hours a month.
The Ohio Valley section elected new officers and will host its first regional meetup in Columbus.
Directors approved revised bylaws and set the date for the election of two new at-large seats.
The external auditors issued a clean opinion on the FY2025 financial statements; operating reserves now cover eight months.
Gold-level partners receive a booth in the exhibit hall, logo placement on lanyards and two complimentary registrations.
The editorial board is seeking reviewers for a special issue on groundwater modeling. Manuscripts are due in March.
Our compensation survey of 3,400 practitioners found median salaries rose 4 percent since the last study.
The new pathways program supports first-generation and underrepresented students entering the profession.
Employers can now post open positions for free, and members can upload resumes for recruiters to browse.
Scholarship applications for undergraduates and graduate students are due December 1.
Pair up with a senior engineer for six months of monthly check-ins and career guidance.
Nominations are open for the Lifetime Achievement Award, presented at the gala dinner.
We are migrating the member database to a new cloud platform this summer; the portal will be down for one weekend.
Under GDPR, members in the EU can request a copy of the personal data we hold or ask us to delete it.
The rebrand launches next month with a new logo, refreshed colours and a social media campaign.
The ethics committee reviewed two complaints of misconduct and issued one formal reprimand.
We signed a memorandum of understanding with the state university to co-host research symposia.
Members now save 15 percent on professional liability insurance and get free access to the standards library.
Rising temperatures are shifting snowmelt timing, which strains reservoir operations across the western states.
Contaminated wells in three counties were linked to an outbreak of gastrointestinal illness.
La inscripción para el congreso anual cierra el 15 de septiembre; los ponentes principales ya están confirmados.
